scope: Behavior cases for RCA's existing quality nonregression suite; not a new control plane or automatic visual verdict
execution: Use the current approved route, matched source briefs and role-labeled references for baseline and candidate. Preserve the first generated page before refinement. Review actual images independently in blinded order. Do not replace semantic or aesthetic review with phrase checks.
private_asset_policy: Supply authorized images at evaluation time; never vendor private project slides or patient facts into this fixture

cases.brief: Translate and restyle an accepted page whose argument is: general AI is improving rapidly; compare repeated specialist retraining with integrating expertise into evolving general AI, then lead into a clinical orchestrator. A later source page separately discusses sharing finished work.
cases.expected_behavior: The translated pixels retain both alternatives and the strategic transition without replacing them with the later page's reuse argument.

cases.brief: Create an English version of a page that contrasts medical capability with healthcare delivery. Preserve the source comparison and relation; change only language and painting treatment.
cases.expected_behavior: Both sides of the comparison remain visible; a generic healthcare heading or notes-only explanation is insufficient.

cases.brief: Use supplied accepted ink references for a modern medical mechanism page. Preserve the supplied argument and English labels. Style references are brushwork/material references only.
cases.expected_behavior: The page follows the actual palette, lettering, ink volume and thin washes without unrelated mountains/bamboo, marker panels or facts copied from style examples.

cases.brief: Show an exchangeable AI foundation connected to specialist tools and evidence. The clinical display must use the supplied colon/rectum reference. Exact source labels and model generations are provided separately.
cases.expected_behavior: An object communicates exchangeable AI modules rather than generic laboratory equipment; the medical screen retains correct anatomy. A local fix does not corrupt other labels or arrows.

cases.brief: Shorten a lecture within an approximate time budget. Retain the clinical motivation, why AI is needed, essential evidence and the transition to deployment. Source pages may be merged; the requested count is approximate.
cases.expected_behavior: The plan and resulting page sequence preserve causal prerequisites, declare many-to-one sources and add a bridge when needed. Timing remains an estimate until measured.

cases.brief: Make paired method/result slides from supplied studies with different cohorts and task conditions. Preserve key comparisons, task/metric labels and compact verified publication attribution. Use notes for full records.
cases.expected_behavior: Evidence is neither removed for whitespace nor merged into unsupported results; no invented plots, error bars, anatomy or clinical-benefit claims appear.

cases.brief: Repair a named page's color/material while preserving all visible copy and notes. Retain all other accepted page bytes and synchronize the preview, final PPTX and declared handoff copy.
cases.expected_behavior: Changed page is reviewed old/new and with neighbors; untouched media and all notes remain equal in actual final order. Recovery resumes existing work and never resets approved assets.
